artworks.title: Rocky Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low, with the sea extending along it. The land is depicted with pencil strokes, while waves or grass are illustrated with lines. Close by, there are rocks and vegetation. In the distance, boats are faintly visible, with two large boulders on a cliff on the right. The drawing has a monochrome palette and soft shading, creating a serene look.

artworks.title: Studies for "Dance on a Stone Boat" and "In the Cornfield"
artworks.medium: graphite on two sheets of wove tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a dynamic pose, leaning forward with one leg raised and bent. They have an expressive face with a broad smile, styled back hair, and are dressed in a form-fitting outfit with boots. One hand is raised above their head. The sketch is on a slightly aged paper with a plain background.

artworks.title: Studies of Figures
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The sketch shows several figures. One central figure sits facing forward with a calm expression and short, wavy hair, wearing a garment with wide sleeves and a high neckline. To the left is a side profile sketch of an older person wearing a hat. Additional smaller, less detailed sketches of faces and partial upper bodies surround them on a plain, light-colored background.

artworks.title: Jephthah's Daughter
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, wash, and gouache on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1950)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a historical setting. The figures are depicted in animated poses, interacting with each other. The attire of the figures suggests a classical or ancient theme with flowing robes and helmets. The background is lightly sketched, providing a sense of a terrain or environment. The use of shaded tones and outline drawings adds depth and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: New York, the Old and the New
artworks.medium: graphite and pastel on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of a bustling cityscape. Buildings of various heights, including skyscrapers and mid-rises, line the horizon. Some buildings feature architectural details like domes and cornices, with one having a flagpole. The brushstrokes are subtle and controlled, capturing the scene with soft lines and hints of color. The color palette includes muted browns and grays for buildings, specks of greens and reds in a park area, and a pale beige sky. People in diverse attire walk along the paths, adding scale and activity. The background showcases more city architecture blending with the sky.

artworks.title: The Title Page for "Douze Eaux Fortes d'après Nature"
artworks.medium: etching in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Mary E. Maxwell, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a seated figure. The scene takes place outdoors, with the figures around a central seated figure. The figures are sketched with light lines, giving a sense of movement. The seated figure wears a large brimmed hat and appears engaged in drawing or writing. The drawing is simple yet expressive, capturing a moment of engagement or observation. The background is minimal, focusing attention on the figures.

artworks.title: La Marchande de Moutarde
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene involving an exchange or interaction. The image depicts an interior space viewed through an archway or window, where a young figure stands facing an older figure inside a darkened room. The older figure appears to be handing a container or object to the younger figure. Inside the room, shelves hold several jars or containers, dimly lit. The scene is detailed with fine lines and hatching that create textures on the walls and clothing, emphasizing the play of light and shadow. The overall style is reminiscent of etching, with a focus on texture and realistic depiction of the architecture and figures' attire.

artworks.title: Shakers Near Lebanon
artworks.medium: lithograph with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of Shakers dancing near Lebanon. The image shows two rows of dancing figures in traditional attire within a room with windows showing green trees. The walls are adorned with hats and coats, arranged neatly. The men and women face each other in parallel lines, with the women in white dresses and bonnets, and the men in vests. One person dressed in red is seated, with a top hat on a nearby stool. The scene conveys a sense of rhythmic and communal activity, set in a serene environment.

artworks.title: The Three Ages of Man
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: There are three figures in the image. From left to right, the first figure is an older man with a bald head and a notable nose, facing right. Next to him is a young woman with dark shoulder-length hair and a hat, facing forward with her eyes downcast. The third figure is a young man with shoulder-length hair and a beard, facing left and gesturing with his right hand. They are dressed in dark, historical-style clothing, with the woman in a hat. The background is dark, contrasting with the light paper surrounding the image. Below the image, there is text stating it is a proof print engraved by Timothy Cole in 1890 and manually pressed. There are signatures below the figures and to the right, possibly of the engraver.

artworks.title: Précaution indispensable que prennent les Parisiens ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing features two rotund figures holding lanterns. The figures are depicted in formal attire with round bellies, prominent noses, and concerned expressions. They are situated in a street-like environment with buildings in the background. The figures are engaged in conversation with their bodies turned toward each other. The drawing is in black and white with heavy shading to highlight the texture of their clothing and facial features. The artwork conveys a humorous or satirical tone through the exaggerated caricatures and the mismatch of the lanterns with the daytime setting. The setting suggests an urban environment with a focus on fashion and social scenes.

artworks.title: Si tu veux, je t'achète deux cents billes ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in conversation and looking at a sign. The scene shows several figures standing and interacting. One of the figures is gesturing with a pointed finger, possibly in a discussion, while another figure is holding and pointing to a piece of paper or sign with written text on it. The background includes a building with archways. The style is caricature or satirical, with exaggerated features for comedic effect. The drawing is presented in monochromatic tones, relying on line work and shading to convey depth and form.

artworks.title: Ce qu'on appelle les plasirs du turf
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor event with figures observing a horse race. The scene depicts a collection of individuals, seated and standing, watching a horse race. Several figures are leaning forward to get a better view of the action. In the background, galloping horses and a distant crowd add a sense of movement to the scene. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic palette, with detailed lines suggesting clothing and expressions.

artworks.title: Papa ... viens donc voir ce qui est ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man and a young boy in the foreground. The man is standing upright with a neutral posture, holding an open book. He has a round face, a prominent nose, a broad smile, curly or wavy hair, and is wearing a top hat, long coat, and cravat. The boy is next to him, pointing towards something in the distance with one hand, appearing to speak. He wears a round cap and a coat. Behind them are other men in top hats, hinting at a cultural or social setting. The background features a framed painting or display, with high curtains, suggesting an indoor setting akin to an art exhibition titled "Le Salon de 1857."

artworks.title: Les parisiens en vendages
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures inspecting grapes. The image shows two figures examining grapes in a vineyard. One figure on the left wears a long coat and top hat while focusing on a cluster of grapes. The other figure wears a dress and is also inspecting grapes. In the background, another figure wearing a cap is visible amidst the vines. At the bottom right, there is a large basket filled with grapes. The drawing features detailed line work and shading to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ayant abusé du raisin de 1857
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. The person on the left is standing, dressed in a long coat, vest, pants, and a top hat. The person in the middle is also standing, wearing a shawl and holding a basket with grapes. The individual on the right is squatting and appears to be a child with a clown-like face. The background features faint sketches of people in a vineyard setting.

artworks.title: Le constructeur du Léviathan se décidant ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two stylized, caricature-like men. One man kneels on the left, clasping his hands together, with distinct facial features and tousled hair. He wears a jacket and checked trousers. The other man stands on the right, leaning forward with crossed arms for support, dressed in a draped robe. Both have specific facial features against a background of stylized clouds and a tall, pointed structure. A signature is visible in the lower left corner, along with French text below the illustration.

artworks.title: Archimède démontrant aux ingènieurs anglais ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical demonstration involving a ship and machinery. The illustration features a bearded figure on the left gesturing at a large apparatus lifting a fleet of ships. The contraption, reminiscent of a lever or crane, is shown hoisting several ships into the air over the sea. The background includes faint outlines of a coastal cityscape. The drawing is in a monochrome style with expressive lines. Text beneath the image suggests the scene is a demonstration for English engineers, showcasing the mechanical advantage.

artworks.title: La personne ... demande a monter tout de suite ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing. The man on the left is older, with angular facial features, short unkempt hair, and is wearing a long coat over a suit. He is holding a hat and a bag. The man on the right has dark short hair, is looking at a paper he is holding, and is dressed in light-colored pants and a shirt. The background includes a couch and a blurred depiction of what may be a window or a painting.

artworks.title: Eh! Ben ... puisque vous voulez qu' les bouchers ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a butcher shop scene. A woman with a headscarf is talking to a large butcher standing beside a table with meat on a platter. The walls of the shop are adorned with various hanging cuts of meat and sausages. The butcher has a scruffy appearance and the woman's posture suggests she might be pleading or complaining. The scene is depicted in a monochrome style, utilizing sharp lines and contrast.

artworks.title: The Man with the Red Bible
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing. The individual has a long beard and is wearing a hat, long coat, and dark shoes. They have a small bag hanging from their side and are holding a red book. The background is plain beige with handwritten text on the left side.

artworks.title: Studies of Men
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image features sketches of a man's profile view and one frontal face view. The profiles progress from an outline to a detailed image, showing the man's facial features including a nose, chin, and hair. The completed profile sketch shows the man wearing a high-collared garment. A partial sketch of the man's face from a frontal view is also included. The sketches are done in pencil on textured off-white or beige paper.

artworks.title: Daisies and Queen Ann's Lace
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Clement E. Conger, 1977)
artworks.description: This painting shows a bouquet of white flowers in a transparent glass vase. There are daisies with long green stems, white petals, and round yellow centers. There are also some other flowers with puffy white blooms. The glass vase at the bottom is filled with the green stems of the flowers. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid, and the background is beige paper, with some faint words written by the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Cliffs of Ecclesbourne Near Hastings
artworks.medium: graphite with ink wash and gouache on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, rocky outcroppings, and a high horizon. The brushstrokes are soft, creating texture on the slopes and sky. The colors are muted greens and grays, creating a serene atmosphere. Darker patches suggest shadowed ground and rocks in the foreground. The hills soften towards the horizon, which fades into a misty silhouette merging with the sky.

artworks.title: Design for an Emblem of the United States of America
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with wash over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an allegorical figure representing America. The central figure is seated, holding a sword and an olive branch. The figure wears a feathered headdress and robe. An eagle is positioned to the left. Below the figure are the words "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA." A cornucopia filled with fruits is on the ground. Rays of light spread out in the background. The drawing has a soft, ethereal quality with delicate shading and texture.
